title: Parcel Shipping Class
description: Read an integer parcel weight w in kilograms and print its shipping class: FREIGHT when w >= 50, STANDARD when w >= 10, LIGHT when w >= 1, otherwise INVALID. Every boundary is inclusive: a weight of exactly 50 is FREIGHT and exactly 1 is LIGHT; a weight of 0 or less is INVALID. This is the transfer variant of 'Grade Band Classifier': same conditional-band skill with inclusive boundaries, different classification context and thresholds. Copying the grade thresholds (85/65/50) cannot produce these answers.
input_format: A single integer w (parcel weight in kilograms).
output_format: A single line: FREIGHT, STANDARD, LIGHT, or INVALID.
